Frame 388 is sharpest, clearly showing the elephant's form and the vehicle's steering wheel. Other frames are blurred due to motion.

Frame 509 best captures the group's dynamic: one cub stands alert on the log, others interact nearby, showing natural poses and expressions under the spotlight. Framing is balanced, with minimal distracting elements.

Sharpness 0.3 enhances grass and zebra detail while avoiding noise. Color and temperature unchanged as scene’s natural tones suit the savanna.

Histogram median at 44 is slightly dark; +0.3 EV brightens it. Skin tones are cool (B 31), so +10 tint adds warmth. Contrast 0.7 enhances skin texture without crushing shadows. Sharpness 0.6 brings out grass detail. Luminance NR 0.4 and color NR 0.3 reduce noise while preserving detail. Clarity 0.4 boosts mid-tones for better definition.

Histogram median at 31 is dark; raising exposure_ev to 0.5 brightens midtones. Scene has low contrast and blown highlights (11% white), so avoid further brightening. Adjustments preserve detail in shadows while reducing overexposure in sky.

Histogram median at 38 suggests underexposure; +0.5 EV brightens midtones. Cool tones (R 48, G 53, B 53) need warmer 5000K to balance. +20 tint adds subtle green. Contrast 0.6 lifts shadows without crushing blacks. Sharpness 0.3 enhances texture. Luminance NR 0.4 reduces noise in midtones. Color NR 0.3 preserves subtle hues. Clarity 0.2 boosts midtone detail. Curve gently brightens shadows and midtones to lift the foggy look.
